caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a reddish-brown color and visible wood grain texture. The box is shown closed and resting on a light, off-white background. Its lid features a small, rectangular golden-colored metal plate in the center. The front side of the box has two small, golden-colored keyholes with escutcheons, symmetrically placed near each corner. The perspective and shading indicate the box is three-dimensional, with the front and top surfaces visible. There are no other objects or details in the composition, and the background remains plain and unadorned.
title: Drawing Instrument Box
